Subject: Novum Health: Storyboarding session for customer narrative (30 min)

Hi Olivia —

Thanks again for agreeing to speak with us about Novum Health's rollout of Redwood. We'd love to capture a short customer story focused on the operational and cost improvements your team has realized so far.

Proposed ask: 30-minute video call where we walk through a short agenda (see below), record the session for editing, and confirm any usage approvals afterward.

High-level agenda (30 min):
- 5m quick intros and context
- 10m run-through of outcomes (latency, cost, reliability examples)
- 10m customer anecdotes / quotes and specific metrics
- 5m next steps & permissions for publishing

Would any of these slots work for you this week?
- Wed 9/16, 10:30–11:00 PT
- Wed 9/16, 2:00–2:30 PT
- Thu 9/17, 11:00–11:30 PT

If none fit, send a couple windows and we’ll adapt. Also: do you prefer we loop in anyone from your comms/legal team now, or wait until after the interview?

I attached a draft agenda/notes. We plan to record the session (for internal editing) — we’ll ask you to sign a short consent form after the call before publishing.

Thanks — excited to tell Novum’s story.

—Jonas
Jonas Weber
Senior Account Exec, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0194
